workflow_metadata.description: High-level decision flow from concept to architecture, development, or feature update with integrated rigor from architecture_workflow.json
workflow_metadata.based_on: UAF 1.2 architecture framework with automated context management

required_tools.purpose: Generate system graph and detect issues

required_templates.purpose: Interface registry format for validation tools

system_isolation.mandatory_check: ALWAYS verify working directory is /path/to/saa/systems/<system_name> before ANY operation
system_isolation.working_directory_rule: cd to systems/<system_name> at the start of EVERY step and substep
system_isolation.path_verification: pwd must equal /path/to/saa/systems/<system_name> before file operations
cross_contamination_prevention: NEVER reference or modify files in other system directories
All file paths must be relative to current system directory or absolute with verified system_name
Before reading ANY file, verify it contains the current system_name in its path
If you find yourself in wrong system directory, STOP immediately and return to correct directory
system_isolation.context_file_location: ALL context files (current_focus.md, working_memory.json, etc.) MUST be in systems/<system_name>/
system_isolation.sanity_check: If system_name from working_memory.json doesn't match pwd, ERROR and STOP

validation_before_every_operation: CONFIRM: No files from other systems will be modified
refresh_sequence: CONFIRM: State system name, step, substep, next action
degradation_signals: Asking about system name when it's in working_memory.json
pwd does not match system_name from working_memory.json

new_concept_or_system.description: A brand-new system or major capability not architected yet

initial_context_setup.validate_setup: Confirm all tracking files created and populated

feature_or_service_change.description: A change to an existing system/service or a new feature

verify: Working memory and progress tracking files exist
prerequisites_check.on_failure: Complete initial architecture before feature changes

implementation_from_final_specs.description: Architecture is complete (build_ready_index.json exists) and development should begin

decisions.question: Is this a new concept/system or a change to an existing one?

before_decision: VERIFY: All prerequisite tools and templates are present
CONFIRM: System working directory if existing system

change.validation: Verify existing system artifacts before proceeding

decisions.question: Has architecture workflow (Steps 0-9) been completed for the target system?

template_validation.success_criteria: All service architectures pass template validation

interface_contracts.verify: All interfaces have complete ICDs generated

no.context_setup: Initialize tracking files and working directory

decisions.question: During development, is a cross-service/contract change required?

impact_analysis.required: Analyze impact on existing interfaces and ICDs

development_quality_gates.SPEC_ALIGNMENT: All code maps to declared interfaces in service_architecture.json
development_quality_gates.BUILD_HEALTH: Clean build with no compilation errors or critical warnings
development_quality_gates.TEST_COVERAGE: Primary path tests + contract tests for all external interfaces
development_quality_gates.SECURITY_BASELINE: All declared authN/authZ paths enforced, no critical static analysis issues
development_quality_gates.OBSERVABILITY_INSTRUMENTATION: Metrics/traces/log events for key operations enumerated in observability.json
development_quality_gates.PERFORMANCE_SMOKE: Baseline throughput & latency within preliminary targets
development_quality_gates.DEPLOYABILITY: Service can be deployed and started in target environment
development_quality_gates.RUNBOOK_COMPLETENESS: Runbook sections: startup, shutdown, config change, dependency outage, scaling, incident triage
development_quality_gates.MISSION_VALIDATION: System demonstrates ability to achieve its stated mission with typical user flows
development_quality_gates.USER_ACCEPTANCE: Real users can accomplish intended tasks in realistic environments

development_constraints: All new code must map to a declared interface or internal function in service_architecture.json
No endpoints added outside api_contracts.json without architecture change workflow
Data schema mutations require synchronized update to data_models.json and migration plan

required_artifacts: index.json with 'components' key mapping service_id to ABSOLUTE path

validation_required.graph_validation: No critical issues in system_of_systems_graph.py analysis
validation_required.interface_validation: All interfaces have complete ICDs generated by generate_interface_contracts.py

quality_assurance: All components have implementation_status with justification
Deployment architecture reconciled with logical architecture

development_bootstrap.validation: All development tracking files created and initialized

validation_required.regression_check: No breaking changes to existing interfaces

development_impact.tracking_update: Update existing dev_progress_tracker.json with new requirements
development_impact.context_refresh: Refresh development context with architectural changes

validate_architecture.purpose: Validate service_architecture.json files against template and interface_registry.json
prerequisites: interface_registry.json must exist in system directory

system_of_systems_graph.purpose: Generate system graph and detect architectural issues
prerequisites: index.json with 'components' key mapping service_id to file paths

generate_interface_contracts.purpose: Generate ICD specifications from service architectures

bootstrap_development_context.purpose: Create development tracking files for service development workflow

bootstrap_automation.description: Automated creation of development tracking files
bootstrap_automation.validates: All required templates exist before creation

development_signals: Schema drift between code and data_models.json
architecture_signals: Asking about system name when in working_memory.json

micro_batching_rules: Split large implementation tasks (>150 lines) into sub-actions
Never open more than 3 services concurrently
Prefer referencing artifact paths over re-inlining large specs
compression_guidelines: Store verbose test output in test_reports/ and reference path only
Document one exemplar for repetitive patterns, then index variations

critical_file_dependencies: index.json MUST have 'components' key for system_of_systems_graph.py
Both files must be created during architecture workflow before validation
Use index_template.json and interface_registry_template.json for correct formats
